attributes.name: Captain's Cutlass
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d6+1; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d8. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

Recharge this card to add 1d6 and the Swashbuckling trait to your non-combat Dexterity or Charisma check.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to a character at your location by 2.
